description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Slap Bmc2 Domain Object within the SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) framework. It provides prototypes for functions managing command handling, domain information retrieval, and state management related to the Bmc2 domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoGetSlapGoaIf
methods.description: Retrieves the Slap GoA interface handle associated with the domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoGetOlmContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the Olm container handle associated with the domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoGetDomainName
methods.description: Returns the name of the domain.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoAddCommand
methods.description: Adds a command to the domain.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoSetCommandSyntax
methods.description: Sets the syntax for a command with required and optional arguments.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoSetCommandSyntaxString
methods.description: Sets the command syntax using syntax strings for required and optional arguments.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoDelCommand
methods.description: Removes a command from the domain.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoIsCommandValid
methods.description: Checks if a command is valid.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoIsCommandAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a command is authorized.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoExitToRoot
methods.description: Exits the domain object to the root context.
